name: list_articles
description: Use this tool to list the articles that are currently published on the site, newest first. Each entry gives the article ID, its headline, the section it belongs to, its authors and the date and time it went live. Results are paginated: pass the cursor returned by the previous call to get the next page. Drafts, scheduled articles and archived articles are not included; use the dedicated tools for those.

section.description: Only return articles of this section, for example politics or sport

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by a previous call

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return, between 1 and 100. Defaults to 20

name: get_article
description: Use this tool to read one article in full when you already know its ID. Returns the headline, the standfirst, the body as Markdown, the section, the tags, the authors, the featured image and the publication status. Works for published, scheduled and archived articles. Returns an error if no article has this ID.

article_id.description: ID of the article to read

name: search_articles
description: Use this tool to find articles by words that appear in their headline, standfirst or body, when you do not know the article ID. Returns the matching articles ranked by relevance, with a short extract around the words found. Searches published and archived articles; set include_drafts to also search drafts the caller can see.

include_drafts.description: Also search drafts. Defaults to false

limit.description: Maximum number of results, defaults to 10

name: create_draft
description: Use this tool to start a new article. It creates a draft that only the newsroom can see; nothing is published. Returns the ID of the new draft, which the other draft tools take. The caller becomes the first author of the draft.

section.description: Section the article will appear in

body.description: Body of the article as Markdown. May be left empty and written later

name: update_draft
description: Use this tool to change the headline, the standfirst or the body of a draft that has not been published yet. Only the fields you pass are changed; the others are kept. Every call saves a new revision, so earlier versions can be restored. To change an article that is already live, unpublish it first or edit its revision.

draft_id.description: ID of the draft to change

standfirst.description: New standfirst, the short paragraph under the headline

name: delete_draft
description: Use this tool to throw away a draft that will never be published. The draft and all its revisions are deleted for good and cannot be restored. Published articles cannot be deleted with this tool; archive them instead.

draft_id.description: ID of the draft to delete

name: list_drafts
description: Use this tool to list the drafts the newsroom is working on, with their headline, authors, last change and review state (writing, in review, changes requested, approved). Filter by author or by review state to see, for example, every draft waiting for an editor.

author_id.description: Only return drafts of this author

state.description: Only return drafts in this review state: writing, in_review, changes_requested or approved

name: submit_draft_for_review
description: Use this tool when the author has finished writing and the draft should go to an editor. It moves the draft to the in review state and notifies the editors of its section. The draft can no longer be changed by its authors until an editor approves it or asks for changes.

draft_id.description: ID of the draft to send to the editors

name: approve_draft
description: Use this tool as an editor to accept a draft that is in review. The draft becomes approved and can then be published right away or scheduled. Requires the editor role on the draft's section. Does not publish anything by itself.

draft_id.description: ID of the draft to approve

name: request_draft_changes
description: Use this tool as an editor to send a draft in review back to its authors with comments on what to fix. The draft goes back to the changes requested state, its authors are notified and can edit it again before submitting it once more.

draft_id.description: ID of the draft to send back

name: publish_article
description: Use this tool to put an approved draft live on the site immediately. The article gets its public URL and its publication date, appears on the home page of its section and in the feeds. Returns the public URL. Fails if the draft has not been approved by an editor.

draft_id.description: ID of the approved draft to publish

name: schedule_article
description: Use this tool to publish an approved draft automatically at a date and time in the future, for example to go live at 6 in the morning. Until then the article stays invisible to readers. The time is given in the newsroom's time zone.

publish_at.description: Date and time to publish, ISO 8601

name: unschedule_article
description: Use this tool to cancel the scheduled publication of an article before it goes live. The article goes back to being an approved draft and keeps its content; nothing is deleted.

name: unpublish_article
description: Use this tool to take a live article off the site, for example after a legal complaint or a serious error. Readers get a page saying the article is no longer available. The article is kept as a draft with all its revisions and can be published again later.

reason.description: Why it is taken down, kept in the history

name: archive_article
description: Use this tool to move an old article to the archive. It stays readable at its URL but leaves the home pages, the feeds and the related articles boxes. Archived articles can still be found with search_articles.

article_id.description: ID of the article to archive

name: list_article_revisions
description: Use this tool to see the history of an article or a draft: every saved revision with its number, the person who saved it and when. Use the revision numbers with compare_article_revisions or restore_article_revision.

article_id.description: ID of the article or draft

name: restore_article_revision
description: Use this tool to roll an article or a draft back to one of its earlier revisions, for example after a bad edit. The content of that revision becomes the current one; it is saved as a new revision, so nothing in the history is lost.

article_id.description: ID of the article or draft

revision.description: Number of the revision to bring back

name: compare_article_revisions
description: Use this tool to see what changed between two revisions of the same article: the words added and removed in the headline, the standfirst and the body, as a diff.

article_id.description: ID of the article or draft

to.description: Newer revision number, the current one when left out

name: list_authors
description: Use this tool to list the people who write for the site: staff journalists, freelancers and guest contributors, with their name, role, sections and whether their account is active.

active.description: Only return active authors when true

section.description: Only return authors of this section

name: get_author
description: Use this tool to read the profile of one author: name, biography, photo, contact email, social accounts, sections and the number of articles published.

name: invite_author
description: Use this tool to give a new journalist, freelancer or guest contributor access to the newsroom. It sends them an email invitation to create their account with the role and sections given.

email.description: Email address of the person to invite

name: deactivate_author
description: Use this tool when someone leaves the newsroom. Their account can no longer sign in; their published articles stay online with their byline. Can be undone by inviting them again.

author_id.description: ID of the author to deactivate

name: assign_article_author
description: Use this tool to change the byline of an article or a draft: add a co-author, replace an author or remove one. The authors given replace the current list.

article_id.description: ID of the article or draft

author_ids.description: IDs of the authors, in byline order

name: upload_media
description: Use this tool to add a photo, a video or an audio file to the media library so it can be used in articles. Returns the media ID. Images are resized automatically for the site.

url.description: URL of the file to fetch

name: list_media
description: Use this tool to browse the media library: photos, videos and audio files with their caption, credit, size and the articles that use them. Filter by type or by words in the caption.

text.description: Words to find in the caption or credit

name: delete_media
description: Use this tool to remove a photo, video or audio file from the media library for good, for example when the rights have expired. Articles that used it show an empty space instead.

media_id.description: ID of the media to remove

name: update_media_caption
description: Use this tool to change the caption, the alternative text or the credit of a photo or video already in the media library. The change shows in every article that uses it.

alt_text.description: New alternative text for screen readers

name: list_comments
description: Use this tool to read the comments readers left under articles, newest first, with their author, the article and the moderation state (pending, approved, rejected). Filter on pending to see the moderation queue.

article_id.description: Only return comments of this article

name: approve_comment
description: Use this tool to publish a reader comment that is waiting in the moderation queue, so it appears under the article.

name: reject_comment
description: Use this tool to refuse a reader comment, for example spam, insults or off topic messages. It never appears under the article. Optionally block the reader from commenting again.

block_reader.description: Also stop this reader from commenting. Defaults to false

name: reply_to_comment
description: Use this tool to answer a reader comment in the name of the newsroom. The reply appears under the comment, marked as coming from the staff.

comment_id.description: ID of the comment to answer

name: list_tags
description: Use this tool to list the tags used to classify articles by topic, place or person, with the number of articles carrying each one.

text.description: Only return tags containing these words

name: create_tag
description: Use this tool to add a new tag to the list of topics articles can be classified under.

name: merge_tags
description: Use this tool to clean up duplicate tags, such as two spellings of the same name. Every article carrying the source tags gets the target tag instead, and the source tags are deleted.

source_tags.description: Tags to fold into the target

name: tag_article
description: Use this tool to set the tags of an article or a draft. The tags given replace the current ones. Tags must already exist; create them with create_tag.

article_id.description: ID of the article or draft

name: send_newsletter
description: Use this tool to send the newsletter by email to every subscriber of a list right now, with the articles chosen. It cannot be called back once sent.

name: schedule_newsletter
description: Use this tool to prepare a newsletter now and have it emailed to a list of subscribers later, at a set date and time.

name: list_newsletter_subscribers
description: Use this tool to see who receives a newsletter: the email addresses on a mailing list, when they signed up and whether they unsubscribed.

name: get_article_stats
description: Use this tool to see how one article is doing with readers: page views, unique visitors, average reading time, share of readers who reached the end, and where they came from.

name: get_traffic_report
description: Use this tool to see the audience of the whole site over a period: visits, page views, the most read articles and sections, and the share of traffic from search engines, social networks and the newsletter.
